newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela oil investment funds seen for Dec 1.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela oil investment funds seen for Dec 1.

text.p: Venezuela's oil investment funds, which will offer Venezuelans their first chance to directly invest in large scale oil projects, will begin operations December 1, state-owned oil company PdVSA president Luis Giusti said.

"The funds project has been delayed a bit while we waited for the CANTV share offering to come to the market," Giusti told reporters after a conference at the Central Bank on oil and the economy. "But December 1 is now our target date."
Originally slated for the beginning of October, the first offering will give Venezuelans the chance to invest in a $500 million Pequiven petrochemical project, Giusti said.
The bonds will be backed by PdVSA and tradable on the Caracas stock exchange.
